item.title: Former DOGE staffers say they just hacked Anthropic in less than 12 hours
item.description: The Trump-connected cybersecurity startup Cathedral says it accessed Anthropic’s internal data and Slack messages by exploiting vulnerabilities in third-party business software. A cybersecurity firm run by former members of Elon Musk’s Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) says it has broken into internal data and messaging systems at Anthropic. Perhaps even more surprising, though, is its claim that it did so in less than 12 hours....
